description: This PHP class defines a validation rule named LessThanOrEqual, which is used within the OrangeHRM system to ensure that a given input is less than or equal to a target value, which can be a closure, DateTime, float, or int.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqual
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an input value is less than or equal to a predefined target object, supporting dynamic target evaluation via callables and date comparisons.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a target object which can be a callable, DateTime, float, or int.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input against the target object to check if it is less than or equal.
